name: Wide screen with knob
look: a tabletop device with a wide screen on the left and a chunky knob on a raised panel on the right
picture_prompt: Product concept render of a small 3D-printable desk device, seen from the front and slightly to one side. It is wider than it is tall. One smooth continuous body with soft rounded corners. On the left of the front is a flat wide rectangular screen, about 55 mm wide and 27 mm tall, in a slim even bezel. On the right is a raised panel with one chunky round knob. One matte plastic colour with a dark screen. Soft studio light, plain light background. Flat bottom, flat back, no text, no logos, no speaker holes, no feet, no visible seams, no cables.
sheet: Front faces -y and stands upright. World +z is up.
Left about 70% of the front: the wide screen, landscape, a separate board just behind the front wall.
Right part of the front: a raised control panel, stepping forward as far as the knob's plugs need, across the full height of the case, with a rounded transition.
The knob comes straight out of that panel toward -y. It is also the button: pressing it clicks. Its pins point -y too.
The controller is a separate board behind the screen, so its USB reaches the left wall. Its top faces the back (+y) and its pins point forward (-y), with their plugs between it and the screen.
USB opens on the left side (-x).
The wires run behind the screen board as one neat bundle and do not show from outside.
The seam is a flat plane near the back, so from the front the Shell looks like one continuous body and the Base is only a rear cover.
The controller sits on a holder built into the rear cover. The rear cover is a flat plate with holder and stops on it, and it closes from +y.
